form.label: ZTA - Centro di comando per la sicurezza
form.description: Dashboard di monitoraggio delle minacce, analisi del comportamento utente (UBA) per l'Architettura Zero Trust

html.h2: 1. Postura Zero Trust & Controllo degli Accessi

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" | timechart span=10m count by decision | sort _time

panel.title: Metodi di Autenticazione Dispositivo (TPM vs. Software)

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" | eval device_type = if(device="no-tpm" OR device="unknown", "Certificato Software (No TPM / Alto Rischio)", "Vincolato all'Hardware (TPM / Basso Rischio)") | stats count by device_type

chart.option: {"Vincolato all'Hardware (TPM / Basso Rischio)": 0x137333, "Certificato Software (No TPM / Alto Rischio)": 0xe67c73}

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" decision="DENY" | eval reason = case( block_reason == "OIDC_TOKEN_INVALID", "Token OIDC Invalido o Scaduto", block_reason == "RISK_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED", "Soglia Rischio Adattiva Superata", block_reason == "INVALID_ACTION", "Azione DB Non Valida", block_reason == "RBAC_DENIED", "RBAC Negato", block_reason == "STEP_UP_REQUIRED", "Biometria Step-Up Richiesta", block_reason == "STEP_UP_STALE", "Biometria Scaduta", block_reason == "UNAUTHENTICATED", "Utente Non Autenticato", block_reason == "ROLE_SEGREGATION_DENIED", "Violazione Separazione Compiti", block_reason == "INSPECTION_VIOLATION", "Violazione Content WAF L7", block_reason == "WAF_BLOCKED", "Bloccato da WAF Envoy (Lua)", 1=1, coalesce(block_reason, "Politica Generica") ) | stats count by reason

panel.title: Allarmi NIDS Snort: PEP vs. Risorsa

search.query: index=zta_snort sourcetype="snort:alert_json" | eval sensor_type = if(sensor=="pep", "PEP", "Risorsa") | stats count by sensor_type, msg

index=zta_nftables sourcetype="nftables:log" action="DROP" | bin _time span=1m | stats count as drops by src_ip, _time | where drops > 15 | stats sum(drops) as total_drops, count(eval(drops > 15)) as active_scanning_minutes by src_ip | rename src_ip as "IP Attaccante", total_drops as "Pacchetti Droppati", active_scanning_minutes as "Minuti di Scansione Rilevati" | sort - "Pacchetti Droppati"

panel.title: Tentativi Brute Force / Accessi Falliti su MongoDB

search.query: index=zta_mongodb_audit sourcetype="mongodb:audit" result!=0 (atype="authenticate" OR "auth") | stats count as fallimenti, values(users{}.user) as utenti_tentati, values(param.user) as utenti_param by ip | eval utenti = coalesce(utenti_tentati, utenti_param) | where fallimenti >= 3 | rename ip as "IP Sorgente", fallimenti as "Tentativi Falliti", utenti as "Username Tentati" | sort - "Tentativi Falliti"

html.h2: 3. Analisi Comportamentale Utenti ed Entità (UEBA) & Rischio Dinamico

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" | bucket _time span=15m | stats count as query_count by user, _time | eventstats avg(query_count) as media, stdev(query_count) as dev_std by user | where _time >= now() - 1800 | eval z_score = if(dev_std > 0, (query_count - media) / dev_std, 0) | where z_score > 2.0 | eval z_score = round(z_score, 2), media = round(media, 1), dev_std = round(dev_std, 1) | rename user as "Utente", query_count as "Query Correnti (15m)", media as "Media Storica", dev_std as "Deviazione Standard", z_score as "Z-Score (Anomalia)" | table "Utente" "Query Correnti (15m)" "Media Storica" "Deviazione Standard" "Z-Score (Anomalia)" | sort - "Z-Score (Anomalia)"

index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" | eval risk_num = tonumber(risk_score) | stats max(risk_num) as max_risk, avg(risk_num) as avg_risk, count(eval(decision="DENY")) as total_denies, values(device) as devices by user, source_address | eval avg_risk = round(avg_risk, 1) | rename user as "Utente", source_address as "IP Chiamante", max_risk as "Risk Score Max", avg_risk as "Risk Score Medio", total_denies as "Totale Dinieghi", devices as "Dispositivo" | sort - "Risk Score Max" | head 15

index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" | eval device_type = if(device="no-tpm" OR device="unknown", "Software", "Hardware TPM") | table _time user role collection command decision risk_score device_type source_address block_reason | rename _time as "Data/Ora", user as "Utente", role as "Ruolo", collection as "Collezione", command as "Azione", decision as "Decisione", risk_score as "Rischio", device_type as "Sicurezza HW", source_address as "IP Client", block_reason as "Motivo Blocco" | head 50
